skill_name: Write a fiction story about a character who is lost in the woods.
workflow: Jane was trudging through the dense woods, feeling more and more lost as the sun fell lower in the sky. Her throat was raw from shouting for help and her worn hiking boots had blisters on her ankles from the long walk. She was just about to give up and take shelter for the night when she noticed a light in the distance. She stumbled towards it, hoping it was a cabin or some other source of comfort.
